headline: Minda Corporation acquires equity shares worth Rs 18 crore in its subsidiary
hook: Capital infusion to back subsidiary operations
summary: Minda Corporation has acquired equity shares worth Rs 18 crore in one of its subsidiaries. This transaction increases the parent company's stake and financial commitment to the subsidiary. Subsidiary investments affect consolidated financials and capital allocation strategies. Retail investors tracking auto ancillaries should note internal capital deployment within the corporate structure.
why_it_matters: Subsidiary capital increase alters consolidated financial commitments.
